record.what_it_does: The Google Ads API lets developers programmatically manage Google Ads accounts, campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, and reporting.
record.auth_notes: OAuth2 (multi-user or service account flow) authenticates the caller, but every API call also requires a separate 'developer token' (a static string tied to a Google Ads manager account) sent as a header alongside the OAuth credentials — the two are used together, not as alternatives.
record.access_notes: Signing up gets you a developer token with free 'Test Account Access' immediately, but that only works against sandbox test accounts. Calling real (production) Google Ads accounts requires applying for and being approved for Explorer/Basic/Standard access, which involves a review (5-10 business days) and, for Basic, Google Cloud project brand verification.
record.main_blocker: developer token approval required for production account access (Basic/Standard access levels)
